name: @epoch/adapter-ifc
description: Epoch Building Model adapter (W029 reference set) — the typed, provider-neutral reference adapter for building-model exchange payloads (source + semantic categories): deterministic, content-addressed ingestion of building-model fixtures (typed rejection ingestion-rejected with reason on malformed/incomplete input — never a partial silent load), and typed semantic projections of building elements, properties, and relationships mapped INTO the W002 world-model graph as REAL AssertionInput records (external-standard semantics are ADAPTED, never authoritative — external-semantics-not-authority typed boundary). Provider vocabulary stays in src/provider (blocklist-tested). In-memory reference behavior: NO network, NO live exchange-format parsers, NO real side effects; fixtures stand in for provider payloads.
